main_text.l: tim ac Sol caput fuum supra noftrum Horizontem,tot millia milliarium tam brevi & quafi imperceptibili temporis fpatio emetiens,attollit,oculos noftros feriunt,) & oppofitum corpus perpendiculariter & ad fundum ufque penetrans, non poffit quin parva ibi vulnera, raritati fuæ ac fubtilitati respondentia, imprimat ; atque cum parvæ iftæ & à fuo trunco diffectæ ac feparatæ atomi, ficut omnia, quæ ordinata hæc mundi feries complectitur corpora, ex quatuor elementis compofita fint, partes lucis calida humidis, vifcofis, ac glutinofis prædicatarum atomorum particulis adhæret, eafque fecum per longinqua fpatia deducit.

Atomos, feu corpufcula phyfice indivifibilia, feu minima naturalia,quorum συγχρίσει contingat rerum generatio, διαχρίσει interitus,non modò Leucippus, Democritus, & Epicurus prodiderunt; fed eandem tuiti fuere Empedocles, Plato, Hippocrates, aliique Antiqui.

page.notes: Greek words in the last paragraph are transcribed as best read; the first line of the first paragraph has a word partly obscured by the binding shadow ("fuo" read as "fuo"). Some Greek accents are doubtful.
